title: Add autonomy handoff restore planner
summary: Handoff bundles can now be exported and verified, but a receiving environment still needs a deterministic, read-only plan for reconstructing tracked patches and untracked files safely. Add a restore planner that reads a verified bundle and emits ordered restore steps without writing files or Git metadata.
expectedFailureModes: A receiving environment applies bundle contents in an unsafe order and loses untracked file data.
The restore plan omits base commit or blocker context required to decide whether restoration is safe.
The restore planner writes files or Git metadata while only planning restoration.
nextAction: Add an autonomy handoff restore planner with stdin/file input and text/JSON output, document it in autonomous workflow docs, and validate it against a generated bundle.
